reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText, setBudget, batchMessages and the undoable/mutator registration, but setLastMonthSpending computes last month's spending with its own SQL over v_transactions_internal_alive instead of the sheet's existing sum-amount-<category> cells already read through getSheetValue.

duplication.why: The four copied category-selection queries are collapsed into getFillableCategories, but the new action adds a second spending computation (with a day-31 date hack) parallel to the sheet values, and the income/tracking skip is still repeated per action.

placement.why: Selection helper and the new action live in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; raw transaction aggregation inside the budget action layer is the one misplaced piece.

scope.why: Edits are limited to month-wide actions, the new method registration and release notes for the three features.

maintainability.why: One selection function owns hidden/template/#fixed exclusions with a single named flag; the separate spending SQL is a second source of truth that can diverge from the budget sheet.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts queries transactions directly instead of reading the sheet's sum-amount-<category> cell via getSheetValue(monthUtils.sheetForMonth(prevMonth), ...)

disguised_duplication.where: The spending SQL is a reimplementation of the sheet sum rather than a renamed copy; the category-selection copies were genuinely merged.

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter, which toggles the hidden filter in its SQL; all five month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth via fillableIds, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) route through it.
